public_rationale: The checkable core is that OpenAI had significant capacity problems in spring 2025. OpenAI's CEO said so directly. On March 31, 2025 he warned that new releases would be delayed, things would break and service would sometimes be slow "as we deal with capacity challenges" (e1). OpenAI also delayed image generation for free users and paused Sora video generation for new users to ease capacity (e2). In early April he cited capacity as one reason for delaying GPT-5 (e3). The second clause, that it was "unclear" where more capacity could come from, states the author's uncertainty and is not scored. Note that OpenAI had signed an $11.9B CoreWeave capacity deal in March 2025 (e4).
limitations: Evidence is OpenAI's own statements as reported by news outlets. No independent measure of capacity shortfall exists.
The second clause is treated as opinion. A reader who scores it as a claim of no expansion options might weigh e4 against it.
